positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Pump Nation, a fitness studio that caters for goal oriented clients

positions.title: Fitness Specialist
positions.description: Tailor Individual clients goals. Generate new clients through new members, referrals, and existing members. Hit monthly goal. Follow up with clients for booking. Establish and maintain a professional relationship with members and clients, educate the fundamentals of human anatomy, correct posture, one-to-one fitness instructions.

positions.title: Membership advisor/ Fitness Consultant
positions.description:
Generate sales through Company and employee sponsored outreach and promotions. Maintains accurate records using established Gold's Gym sales systems. Follow up on all prospects. Conduct gym tours.Conducts telephone inquiries.
Establish and maintain lead boxes in the community on a monthly basis. Establish and maintain a referral program Maintains information on club history, background, philosophy, facilities, staff and policies. Have a thorough knowledge of, adheres to, and enforces Company policies and procedures as they pertain to gym operations.
Assume responsibility for developing selling skills.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Generate sales through referral as well from walk in customers. Achieve a sales goal of $7,000, provide excellent customer service, develop an understanding of customers need, up sell product. thorough knowledge on product. Make customer feel excited about the product.

positions.title: Assistant Fitness Director/ Fitness Director
positions.description: Garner and achieve a sales goal of $15,000 each pay period, manage customers billing account, assist and provide solutions to customer with service problems, mange personal trainers clients. educate the customer on the product through, offer solutions based on the customers’ financial needs. Generate 20 phone calls each hour, make eight to ten appointment a day.

positions.title: Personal Trainer
positions.description: Create specific tailored exercise plan for clients goal, educate the fundamentals of human anatomy, correct posture,  one-to-one fitness instructions.

positions.title: Call Center Associate
positions.description: Garner and achieve a daily sales goal of 20 service packages, manage customers billing account, upgrade an average of 15 customer packages, assist and provide solutions to customer with service problems, access computer problem through command prompt, educate the customer on the product through, offer solutions based on the customers’ financial needs.

positions.title: Service Center Associate
positions.description: Responsible for guest pass sales at the register, provide excellent service to members and guests, enforce and educate members on campus policies and fitness routines as a UTB class fitness instructor, monitor members for any potential medical emergency, assist promptly with emergency situations and evacuations, organize equipment, perform tours and guides on the facility, enhance campus recreation experience.

positions.description: Manage and organize patients’ files, create data spreadsheets, scheduled and confirm appointments, answer phone courteously, perform CPR when necessary, monitor patients’ vital signs, and shadow assigned nurse.
